notes.title: MagicMic-Real-time Voice Changer V1.0.2
notes.notes:
[b]Dear players, [/b]
We are happy to announce that the software has received a new version update! We have made a number of optimizations and fixes in this update, including interface localization, new features, and bug fixes. 
Thank you all for your support and feedback, and we look forward to your experience!

[h1]Localization[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Supported new languages: Russian and Thai.
[*]The sound effect library supports Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese.
[/olist]
